product_overview: DuncoHMS is a comprehensive hospital management system designed to streamline and automate operations for hospitals, clinics, and healthcare facilities. Built on a modern Laravel and JavaScript tech stack, it offers multi-role support, extensive modules for patient, staff, billing, and inventory management, integrated AI virtual nurse assistance, and advanced IoT and telemedicine features to enhance healthcare delivery and administration.
core_goals: Provide end-to-end hospital management covering patient lifecycle, staff, finances, and resources.
Enable secure and role-based access control for various hospital user types including doctors, nurses, and administrators.
Offer a fully integrated patient portal for managing appointments, medical records, and billing.
Incorporate AI-driven virtual assistance and predictive analytics for improved operational efficiency.
Support multi-branch hospital setups with modular architecture and API-first design.
Ensure high standards of security, data privacy, and compliance including GDPR and HIPAA.
Deliver a responsive, multi-language, and multi-currency web interface with real-time dashboards and analytics.
key_features: Comprehensive modules for patient, doctor, nurse, appointment, bed, pharmacy, laboratory, radiology, billing, inventory, and staff management.
AI-powered Elliana D Virtual Nurse Assistant for natural language medical query and appointment booking with OpenRouter AI integration.
Multi-role access with granular permissions and audit logging for security and compliance.
Integrated telemedicine support with session management and planned video call integration.
IoT and RFID integration for real-time bed and asset monitoring.
Multi-branch hospital support with customized settings per branch.
Robust API providing RESTful endpoints for patients, appointments, doctors, billing, lab, and AI assistant functions.
Full CMS for public-facing content management including blogs, galleries, and careers.
Comprehensive reporting system covering patient, financial, and operational analytics.
Automated queue and visitor management systems with real-time status updates.
user_flow_summary: User authentication and role-based dashboard access: Users log in and are routed to role-specific dashboards based on their permissions.
Patient lifecycle management: Registration, case recording, appointment booking, treatment, billing, and discharge workflows.
AI assistant interaction: Patients or staff engage Elliana D via chat interface to book appointments or get medical info through natural language queries.
Appointment system: Booking (online/offline), rescheduling, notifications, and calendar integration for patients and staff.
Inventory and pharmacy stock management: Add, track, and dispense medicines and supplies with alerts for low stock.
Laboratory and radiology management: Test ordering, sample tracking, image uploads, and result delivery to clinicians.
Billing cycle: Invoice generation, payment collection, record keeping, and financial reporting.
IoT device data flow: Real-time bed sensor data monitored on dashboards with RFID tracking for assets and patients.
Telemedicine session scheduling with patient-doctor remote consultations and session tracking.
Content management workflows for public pages, blogs, testimonials, and career postings.
validation_criteria: All modules must support complete CRUD operations with appropriate validation and error handling.
Role-based access controls enforced consistently across routes and UI components.
AI assistant must correctly identify intent and provide accurate fallback responses when API integration is unavailable.
API endpoints conform to RESTful standards, provide JSON responses, and handle errors gracefully.
Frontend responsiveness verified across supported browsers and devices with Tailwind CSS and Alpine.js.
Security features such as multi-factor authentication, data encryption, and audit logging must be implemented and tested.
System performance metrics meet defined thresholds: page load under 2 seconds, API response under 500ms.
Integration points for payment gateways, SMS, email, and AI services must be functional and tested.
Automated and manual tests covering unit, feature, API, frontend, and integration scenarios achieve target code coverage.
Documentation and user manuals are up-to-date and cover all aspects of system use and administration.
